description: Paid providers and their limits (spec 8.5, owner-only). gate-spend (FRG-5) refuses any command naming a provider's hosts, key_vars or commands (its command-line tools, which read a key from the environment), the payments section's, or an always_blocked text, whether or not the provider is enabled; only a project's budget wrapper (FRG-11) will be exempt. Every provider but manual, and payments, must list all three (empty is fine). Only manual is enabled, with a cap of 0.

payments.description: Payments charge customers, not the owner, so they never go through the budget wrapper (spec 8.7).
